senses.gloss:
रुज् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (रुजति, रुग्ण)
1 To
break to pieces, destroy;
R. 9. 63, 12. 73; Bk. 4. 43.
--2
To pain, injure, disorder, afflict
with disease, (sometimes with gen);
रावणस्येह रोक्ष्यंति कपयो भीमविक्रमाः
Bk. 8. 120.
--3 To bend. {vII.v} {c10c} U.
(रोजयति-ते) To hurt, kill.

रुज्, रुजा f. [रुज्-क्विप् वाटाप्]
1
Breaking, fracture.
--2 Pain, torment,
pang, anguish; अनिशमपि
मकरकेतुर्मनसो रुजमावहन्नभिमतो मे Ś. 3. 4; क्व
रुजा हृदयप्रमाथिनी M. 3. 2; चरणं
रुजापरीतं 4. 3.
--3 Sickness, malady,
disease; R. 19. 52.
--4 Fatigue, toil,
[]
effort, trouble.
--5 A ewe.
--6
Leprosy.
--Comp.
--कर a. causing
pain, sickening.
--(रः) a disease,
sickness, illness.
--प्रतिक्रिया
counteraction or treatment of disease, curing,
practice of medicine.
--भेषजं a
medicine.
--सद्मत् n. feces,
excrement.
